notes.title: Boogie Cruise Demo Launch
notes.content: The default branch has been updated to deliver the official Boogie Cruise demo. This build includes core demo content designed to showcase the game's mechanics, visual style, and overall feel. We welcome feedback as we continue development toward full release.
